item.title: Kanosora
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Milksoft
  • 発売日: 2004-10-29
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏ノ空－カノソラ－
  • 英語名: Kanosora

あらすじ

Naruse Kyouichi was a normal 2nd year student when he helps out a girl in the school hallway and gets thanked by Himemiya Sakurako - soon after this, all the students get called into the courtyard, where Sakurako announces that she found a new Student Council President - and calls out Kyouichi’s name.

So begins Kyouichi’s new life, with his childhood friend Chinatsu who joined the Council with him, Yuma, who wants become his imouto, Nao the shy girl whom he helped, Anzu, a young kitsune who is a shimapan maniac and Sakurako.

item.title: Hi no Tsuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Milksoft
  • 発売日: 2003-10-24
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 緋の月
  • 英語名: Hi no Tsuki

あらすじ

End of Edo period.

Main character travels with a master of the sword searching for Kanzaki who killed protagonist’s adopted father. In the middle of the trip they get caught up in a case in a small port town. In the mids of investigation the name of Kanzaki shows up, but in a new context - linked to gods, opus and castle lord. The hour of revenge draws near.

item.title: Kaze no Uta
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Milksoft
  • 発売日: 2002-08-23
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 風ノ唄
  • 英語名: Kaze no Uta

あらすじ

The story takes place in a small rural area around the seaside town called Sakuragi-cho. The protagonist returns from Tokyo to spend the summer in a town which brings him a lot of nostalgic memories. But after being absent for so long, unaware about the current events in the town, the summer vacations may not be so carefree and relaxing as you expect them to be.
